title: Normalized finite-discrete section-action coefficient encoding
statement: Let A be a finite discrete commutative topological ring in Type u and T a scheme in universe u. Define coefficient, Internal, Ordinary, sectionRing, pointConstants, canonicalAbelianMap, fixedRestriction, sectionEncoding, Encoding, its actual termwise ordinaryDerived and fixedDerived equivalences, and the ordinary local-model, constructibility and finite-Tor predicates exactly as in the attached declarations. Encoding consists of the canonical constant-ring/section-ring isomorphism normalized on every constant scalar, the section-action followed by scalar restriction equivalence, and the fixed-scalar restriction equivalence; all forward and inverse functors are additive. Then Encoding A T is nonempty.

source.place: Coefficient-identification argument, steps 1--3 and scalar naturality in step 8.

proof.text: Finite clopen fibres indexed by Fin(card A) show local surjectivity of constant functions, and separatedness with the empty cover shows local injectivity. Sheafification and inverse image yield the canonical abelian isomorphism. Its monoidal compatibility gives a section-ring map by the sheafification adjunction. Forgetting to abelian groups reflects invertibility; the adjunction unit proves the prescribed normalization.

Compose the section-action equivalence with identity-site scalar transport through this isomorphism. Compose constant-ring scalar transport with constant_ring_module_sheaves to obtain fixed scalars. These forward functors are definitionally the required sectionEncoding and fixedRestriction. Additivity follows from the section-action comparison and identity underlying maps; inverses of additive equivalences are additive.

proof_origin.note: The original public statement is unchanged. This node isolates a proper part of its argument. The construction and scalar naturality are proved in Lean.
